messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about nutrition policy in Germany and Berlin during the 2020s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Germany nutrition policy monitoring dataset 2020 2024 food environment RKI
Berlin open data school meals nutrition food policy dataset
action.query: Germany nutrition policy monitoring dataset 2020 2024 food environment RKI

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Germany Food Environment Policy Index (Food-EPI), 2020–2021","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.1017/S1368980021004742","justification":"Highly relevant dataset and policy assessment examining Germany's nutrition policies during 2020–2021. Includes expert evaluations of 47 policy indicators, benchmarking against international best practices, and prioritized recommendations for improving food environments. Particularly useful for studying nutrition policy implementation, government action, food labeling, school nutrition, and public health governance."},{"title":"Food-EPI Germany: Evidence Report","url_or_doi":"https://www.jpi-pen.eu/images/reports/Food-EPI_Germany_Evidence_Report.pdf","justification":"Supporting evidence compilation for Germany's Food Environment Policy Index assessment. Documents nutrition-related policies, regulations, government initiatives, and implementation evidence around 2020. Useful for constructing a policy inventory and analyzing gaps between German nutrition policies and international recommendations."},{"title":"BMEL Nutrition Report 2024 (Ernährungsreport 2024)","url_or_doi":"https://www.publikationen-bundesregierung.de/pp-de/publikationssuche/ernaehrungsreport-2024-2311238","justification":"Official German federal government report containing results from a representative population survey on dietary habits, food purchasing decisions, nutrition preferences, and expectations of government food policy. Published in September 2024, it provides quantitative survey findings relevant to evaluating public support for nutrition policy interventions. The landing page provides the report rather than a confirmed downloadable microdata file."},{"title":"German Nutrition Society Nutrition Reports, 2020 and 2024","url_or_doi":"https://www.dge.de/english/nutrition-reports/","justification":"Official collection of German Nutrition Society reports commissioned by the federal government. The 2020 and 2024 editions provide statistical evidence on food consumption, nutritional status, dietary patterns, and nutrition-related health challenges. Useful for establishing national nutrition baselines and evaluating the context of German nutrition policy during the 2020s. These are statistical reports rather than confirmed raw-data downloads."},{"title":"Berlin School Catering: Fair-Certified Food Indicator, 2017–2025","url_or_doi":"https://sdg-treptow-koepenick.de/en/2-2-1/","justification":"Directly relevant Berlin-level quantitative indicator tracking the number of food products required to be fair-trade certified in Berlin's school catering system. Provides annual observations from 2017 through 2025, allowing analysis of policy changes introduced in August 2020. Particularly useful for examining sustainable food procurement, public school meal standards, and local nutrition governance."},{"title":"Berlin Nutrition Standards in Schools and Daycare Centers: Health Monitoring Indicator 5.3.3","url_or_doi":"https://www.berlin.de/ba-steglitz-zehlendorf/politik-und-verwaltung/service-und-organisationseinheiten/qualitaetsentwicklung-planung-und-koordination-im-oeffentlichen-gesundheitsdienst/artikel.1567867.php","justification":"Official Berlin district health-monitoring indicator documenting implementation of German Nutrition Society quality standards in schools and daycare centers. Updated in 2025, it identifies applicable nutritional standards, administrative data sources, and responsible authorities. Relevant for evaluating implementation of Berlin's public-sector nutrition policies. The indicator documents policy requirements rather than providing a detailed institution-level dataset."},{"title":"Berlin Food Safety Annual Reports (Jahresberichte zur Lebensmittelsicherheit in Berlin)","url_or_doi":"https://www.berlin.de/sen/verbraucherschutz/aufgaben/lebensmittelueberwachung/artikel.1609690.php","justification":"Official Berlin government collection of annual food safety monitoring reports. Contains results of inspections conducted at food establishments under public food-control regulations. Useful for analyzing local food-policy enforcement, regulatory oversight, and food safety governance during the 2020s. Focuses on food safety rather than dietary quality or nutritional outcomes."},{"title":"Berlin Senate Department for Education: Open Data Portal","url_or_doi":"https://www.berlin.de/sen/bildung/service/daten/","justification":"Official Berlin education administration data portal, relevant for identifying datasets on schools, educational institutions, and administrative structures associated with school meal provision. Can support district-level analysis of nutrition policy coverage when combined with school catering and nutrition-standard indicators. The portal is a potential source of supporting data, not a dedicated nutrition dataset."},{"title":"German Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food: Statistical Publications","url_or_doi":"https://www.bmel-statistik.de/publikationen","justification":"Official German government statistical resource covering food, agriculture, and related economic sectors. Includes recurring statistical publications and tables that can support analysis of national food supply, food-sector developments, and the economic context of nutrition policy during the 2020s. Particularly useful for constructing national contextual indicators, although the collection is broader than nutrition policy."},{"title":"Robert Koch Institute: Nutrition and Dietary Behaviour Monitoring","url_or_doi":"https://www.rki.de/EN/Topics/Noncommunicable-diseases/Healthy-living/Nutrition-and-dietary-behaviour/nutrition-and-dietary-behaviour.html","justification":"Official German public health institute resource describing national dietary monitoring and nutrition-related survey instruments. Relevant for identifying population health surveys, dietary frequency measures, and nutritional behavior indicators that can inform evaluations of nutrition policy. Provides methodological information and access pathways to related studies rather than a single downloadable dataset."},{"title":"Berlin District Sustainable Development Indicators: Fair Food Procurement in School Meals","url_or_doi":"https://sdg-treptow-koepenick.de/en/2-2-1/","justification":"Berlin's Treptow-Köpenick sustainable development monitoring framework includes an annual indicator specifically documenting fair-trade procurement requirements in school catering. The 2020–2025 observations provide a compact local policy time series that can be combined with other district and city-level indicators. This is the same underlying indicator as the Berlin School Catering entry, included to highlight its value for district-level SDG monitoring rather than as an independent dataset."},{"title":"German Nutrition Policy Assessment: Food-EPI Study and Policy Implementation Evidence","url_or_doi":"https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9991688/","justification":"Open-access version of the German Food-EPI study, containing policy implementation ratings, expert assessments, and prioritized nutrition-policy interventions. Its tables provide structured information on policy performance and recommendations. Particularly useful for examining the German policy environment in 2020–2021 and comparing national measures with Berlin initiatives. This is an alternative access point to the Food-EPI study listed above, not a separate dataset."}]}
